Murkrow

Dark Flying

Johto · Generation 2

Murkrow is a Dark/Flying-type Darkness Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 2.1 kg. It evolves into Honchkrow. Its highest base stat is Speed (91), with a base stat total of 405.
